summary: Focused mobile preview checks passed for player navigation, monitoring defaults, validation, save without playlist, heartbeat error handling, and intercepted heartbeat payload. TypeScript compilation passed. Public backend health and Drive endpoints returned 502 because the backend supervisor lacks MONGO_URL/DB_NAME environment configuration.

critical.issue: Public endpoint returns 502; backend process startup logs show KeyError: MONGO_URL due missing backend environment configuration.
Public endpoint returns 502 for the same backend environment/startup failure, so Drive regression could not execute.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend backend client reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, while the stated deployment contract uses EXPO_BACKEND_URL; the checked-out frontend/.env is missing. Monitoring itself is independent and passed.

action_items: Restore/provide backend MONGO_URL and DB_NAME so supervisor starts a functional API.
Align frontend backend URL lookup with the configured EXPO_BACKEND_URL contract (or ensure EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is deliberately injected).
Re-run Drive and Save e Reproduzir integration after environment correction.
critical_code_review_comments: Monitoring service is globally started in _layout and uses POST JSON with the required fields; no mocked API was used in the implementation.
URL validation checks only an http/https prefix, so malformed values such as https:// can pass client validation and should be rejected before sending.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile viewport 375x667: player loaded, settings navigation worked, defaults were empty/URL/20, invalid URL and interval 4 were rejected, monitoring saved without playlist, intercepted success heartbeat payload matched tv_code/status/timestamp ISO/app_version, HTTP failure displayed, and return to player worked. yarn tsc --noEmit passed.
rca_of_issue: Backend supervisor imports server.py with os.environ['MONGO_URL']; backend/.env is absent in the checked-out workspace, causing process startup failure and ingress 502 responses. Frontend playlist integration is additionally at risk because backend.ts uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL while the environment contract names EXPO_BACKEND_URL.
